answer: The velvet holds work receipts rather than names, so the quill of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, capped per identity per epoch, rewards vest against future work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the thread of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
